subject: Cross-functional: signal ownership matrix & acceptance criteria for eval regressions
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Request: signal correlation matrix for recent quality regressions

Hi Logan,

Quick note from the Acme side — over the past two weeks we've seen a spike in user-reported hallucinations in our summarization flow after your latest promptset rollout. Our engineers suspect it's related to upstream signal weighting in the reranker/eval gating. Can we get a short cross-functional pass to map which evaluation signals Redwood considers authoritative (and their owners) so we can align triage?

We'd love a deliverable that covers:
- signal name + definition (e.g., prompt-consistency, factuality-score)
- where the signal is computed (runtime, post-process, offline)
- ownership (product, infra, research)
- acceptance thresholds for A/B / canary gating

We can share examples if useful. Appreciate any owner-level contacts so we can open a joint postmortem if needed.

Thanks,
Claire Z.
Data Science Lead, Acme Analytics
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: signal correlation matrix for recent quality regressions

Thanks Claire — we'll take this on.

Marissa / Naomi / Dev / Hannah: can each of you own the portion below and consolidate into a single matrix by EOD Wednesday (2028-05-03)? Claire asked for something consumable for her execs and the eng triage team. My proposed split:
- Marissa: behavioral/acceptance signals (prompt-consistency, toxicity, safety flags) + owner mapping
- Naomi: quality metrics (factuality-score, rouge/bleu proxies, hallucination detectors) + thresholds used in canaries
- Dev: infra/runtime signals (latency spikes, token-truncation events, kv-cache misses) and where they're computed
- Hannah: rollout/AB gating logic (how signals feed into canary fail/fallback) and docs link

I'll collate and produce a one-page matrix and an action list for a joint call. Attach my draft mapping (signal-mapping-v1.xlsx) — it's rough but should speed things up.

Logan
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: signal correlation matrix for recent quality regressions

On Fri, May 3, 2028 at 9:12 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa: behavioral/acceptance signals (prompt-consistency, toxicity, safety flags) + owner mapping

Acknowledged. I'll pull the current prompt-consistency rubric and the latest safety flag false-positive rates. Two quick asks:
1) For "prompt-consistency" we have both a lexical-similarity metric and an embedding-based semantic similarity; do you want both columns or only the semantic one?
2) For owner mapping, do we mark teams (e.g., Research / Product) or individuals (name + email)?

Plan: assemble my sheet and drop a PDF (meeting-notes-20280503.pdf) with a one-paragraph explanation for each signal. ETA: 3pm PT.

- Marissa
Senior PM, Evals & Quality
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: signal correlation matrix for recent quality regressions

Quick clarification: acceptance thresholds differ by evaluation context (A/B on production traffic vs. offline batch eval). For the matrix, I'll include two columns: "offline threshold" and "live canary threshold" with current numeric cutoffs and the rationale.

Also, FYI — the factuality model used for the factuality-score was retrained 2028-03-28; I'll note any known drift windows.

Naomi
Applied ML — Quality Signals
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: signal correlation matrix for recent quality regressions

Heads up on data availability: runtime token-truncation events and kv-cache-miss metrics are only retained at 7 days in our hot telemetry. If Acme needs a longer window for correlation analysis we'll need to pull cold logs (Elastic archive) — I can script an export but that'll add ~24-36 hours. Also, the current reranker instrumentation doesn't log internal confidence buckets by default; I can add a lightweight telemetry flag for the next canary if we agree.

- Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 4 May 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: signal correlation matrix for recent quality regressions

Great progress, team — thank you. Final notes / owners and next steps:
- Marissa: finalize signal definitions and attach the PDF (deliverable: signal-matrix v1) — owner: marissa_cole — due 2028-05-03 15:00 PT (received)
- Naomi: populate offline vs live thresholds + note retrain windows — owner: naomi_feldman — due 2028-05-03 17:00 PT (received)
- Dev: run cold log export for the 2028-04-10 -> 2028-04-24 window and share csv; add reranker confidence telemetry for the upcoming canary (opt-in flag) — owner: dev_patel — ETA 2028-05-05
- Hannah: produce a short runbook of how the gating pipeline will react to threshold breaches and where to toggle fallbacks — owner: hannah_schmitt — ETA 2028-05-06

I'll combine into a one-page matrix and schedule a 30-minute sync with Claire + Acme eng in next business day. Claire — can you do Tue 2028-05-07 10:00am PT? If so I'll send the invite and the combined sheet.

Logan
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
